messages.text: When I select to buy 2 it won't give a shipping date..currently showing 8 available when I only purchase 1..is there any delay buying 2?Sent from my Galaxy
Handed to the team · Product settings are Georges' to change; listing is missing the ship date on mul

Hi there,

No, buying two doesn't add any delay. The Magic M. 40T 2-unit option comes from the same Batch 10 as the single unit. Batch 10 ships Dec 21, 2026, whether you buy one or two.

The date only went missing because the 2-unit option on the page doesn't have its ship date filled in. I've asked the team to fix that on the listing.

The 2-unit option is $1,498, so you save $100 compared with buying two singles at $799 each.

Best regards,
Sarah
